read.en: Sandisk fell 1.5% on Nov 17 to $797.24, trading $749.70–821.46. It is below the 5-day ($881.3), 10-day ($883.2), 30-day ($1,201.5), 100-day ($1,473.6) and 200-day ($1,284.3); all but the 200-day are falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($1,079.91), and RSI is 30.9.

The close broke the $799–806.4 support (Nov 16 low, Nov 5 low and close), now resistance, after the $749.70 low tested the round $750 and held. Resistance is $799–806.4, then $816.4–838.5 (Nov 6 low, Nov 17 high, Nov 6 close, Nov 16 high) and $848.5–860. Support is $749.7–750, then $700. A close above $806.4 would target $816–838; below $749.7, $700.
